posts.text: I'm proud of my Jamaican heritage, and I'm proud to stand alongside a community whose spirit, culture, and contributions are crucial to the makeup of our state.

I was the first governor in the country to ban state employees from using insider information to profit on prediction markets. 

We work for the people, not to get rich.

Nobody should have to justify their own humanity, and as long as I am Governor of this state, we will fight for the humanity, rights, and freedoms of our fellow Americans, including our LGBTQ+ community.

When Judge Wilkinson was sworn in, he said: “I wanted to become a judge to serve the community.” He chose to serve at his YMCA, at food banks, as a youth soccer and little league baseball coach. 

This school takes in students and it produces leaders. That's the Mercersburg legacy that the Class of 2026 will continue to build on. 

Thank you to Mercersburg Academy and the Wilkinson family for the honor of delivering this year’s commencement address.

In this week’s bill signing, we delivered for Marylanders across the entire state by signing into law legislation that boosts our state’s housing production, helps our students by supporting distraction-free education, and makes the largest investment in child care in Maryland history.

I have directed @MdAgDept and @MDEnvironment to coordinate a response to the two crises affecting our agricultural community: the late April freeze and the ongoing drought designation affecting the majority of Maryland counties. 

This follows my request from earlier this week to the @USDA for federal disaster aid – including emergency loans and supplemental relief programs – for Maryland producers.

Eid Mubarak to all who are celebrating Eid al-Adha this week 🌙

I know this year’s celebration of this blessed day will be held alongside profound grief for many families mourning the loss of their loved ones who were killed while heroically protecting children and their community.

To our Muslim friends and neighbors: You are loved and deserve safety, and our administration will continue to work to ensure you, and all of our faith communities, are safe in your places of worship.

Let’s talk housing. And transit. And how they’re linked together.

Today, we will hold our fourth and final post-session bill signing ceremony of the year. 

I will sign into law the Maryland Housing Certainty Act, the Maryland Transit and Housing Opportunity Act, the Joanne C. Benson Maryland Phone-Free Schools Act, and other legislation focused on housing, community development, and education.

go.md.gov/FourthBillSigning

Today, we honor the 13 service members who made the ultimate sacrifice this year in the Iran War.

They remind us what courage looks like. Their legacy endures in every Marylander that raises their hand and puts on the uniform and their names will always be remembered.

Video

Thank you, Valley Forge Military Academy, for all you gave me and every cadet who called your campus ‘home.’

Video

We are proud to stand with our veterans, service members, military families, caregivers, and Gold Star families today.

Thank you to Secretary Rothstein and the entire Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families for your deep commitment to supporting those who served and living up to a simple promise: Leave no one behind.

God bless you all, and God bless the State of Maryland.
